newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: St George securitises A$500 mln mortgages.
newsitem.headline: St George securitises A$500 mln mortgages.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Wednesday that it would securitise A$500 million of mortgages from its Great Australian Home Loan product as part of an ongoing strategy to diversify its funding base and manage its capital requirements.
St George said the issue would be supported by about 4,000 residential mortgages.
It said the securities would be floating rate pass through bonds and were expected to be rated AAA by Standard and Poor's Corp and Aaa by Moody's Investor Services.
Bankers Trust Australia Ltd would act as the bank's adviser and sole dealer for the issue.
